caption: The drawing depicts a single parasol or umbrella placed diagonally, with the handle positioned toward the bottom left and the canopy extending toward the top right. The handle is elongated, cylindrical, and depicted in shades of brown, suggesting a wooden material, with a rounded knob at the end. The canopy of the parasol is an irregular light beige or tan color, textured with visible veins and folds, possibly to represent a thin, organic material. The edge of the canopy is trimmed with a rough, uneven, dark border, almost black in color, that contrasts sharply with the light central area. The background consists of a plain, off-white or cream-colored surface with a thin red line forming a rectangular inner border around the edges of the page.
title: Parasol
